homeSlides.title: History of Aetheria
homeSlides.description: Forged over a decade of dedicated indie development, Legends of Aetheria brings back the classic, cooperative feel of timeless MMORPGs where player decisions and community bonds truly matter.

story.title: 🌌 Legends of Aetheria
story.subtitle: The Shattered World
paragraphs: Long ago, the world of Aetheria was protected by the Celestial Crown, an ancient artifact that kept the realms in balance. When the Crown shattered, its fragments fell across the world, awakening forgotten gods, cursed kingdoms, and creatures from beyond the stars.

Players must choose their race and class, explore dangerous realms, form alliances, defeat rival factions, and collect the fragments of the Celestial Crown before Aetheria collapses into eternal chaos.

features.label: Customization
features.title: Character Customization
features.description: Create a character that feels uniquely yours with a wide range of appearance, equipment, and personalization options.

features.label: Leveling
features.title: Leveling
features.description: Progress your character through combat, quests, exploration, and achievements while unlocking new abilities and equipment.

features.label: Dual Classing
features.title: Dual Classing
features.description: Combine two distinct job paths to create unique synergies, tailoring your abilities and playstyle to suit any challenge.

features.label: Mounts
features.title: Mounts
features.description: Travel across the vast world of Aetheria with mounts ranging from dependable steeds to fantastic creatures of legend.

features.label: PvP
features.title: PvP
features.description: Test your skills against other players through faction warfare, competitive battles, and dangerous conflicts across Aetheria.

features.label: Housing
features.title: Player Housing
features.description: Claim your own place in Aetheria and turn it into a personal home, gathering space, trophy room, or headquarters for your adventures.

features.label: Crafting
features.title: Crafting
features.description: Gather resources throughout the world and transform them into useful gear, consumables, decorations, and valuable items.

features.label: Exploration
features.title: Exploration
features.description: Venture beyond the beaten path to discover hidden locations, ancient ruins, secret treasures, dangerous creatures, and forgotten mysteries.

realms.label: Ironpeak
realms.title: Ironpeak Mountains
realms.description: A towering mountain range filled with sky temples, ancient mines, and clans of battle-hardened guardians. Storms constantly circle the highest peaks.

realms.label: Sunscorch
realms.title: Sunscorch Desert
realms.description: A vast golden desert hiding buried cities, colossal sandworms, and merchant kingdoms that control the world's rarest resources.

realms.label: Frostveil
realms.title: Frostveil Tundra
realms.description: A frozen wasteland where ancient ice dragons sleep beneath the glaciers and wandering spirits guide travelers through endless snow.

realms.label: Whispering Mire
realms.title: Whispering Mire
realms.description: A poisonous swamp filled with ancient trees, hidden villages, witch covens, and creatures that mimic the voices of lost travelers.

realms.label: Azure Expanse
realms.title: Azure Expanse
realms.description: A massive ocean region containing pirate kingdoms, underwater temples, sea monsters, and islands that appear only during eclipses.

realms.label: Emberfall
realms.title: Emberfall Caldera
realms.description: A volcanic wasteland ruled by fire giants and molten war machines. The land changes whenever the central volcano erupts.

realms.label: Cloudspire
realms.title: Cloudspire Isles
realms.description: Floating islands suspended above the clouds, connected by magical bridges and guarded by storm spirits and ancient sky pirates.

realms.label: Umbral Hollow
realms.title: Umbral Hollow
realms.description: A realm trapped in permanent darkness where shadows take physical form and forgotten memories become dangerous enemies.

races.label: Star Elves
races.title: Star Elves
races.description: Elegant descendants of celestial beings who draw power from starlight and possess a deep connection to ancient magic.

races.label: Dwarves
races.title: Stoneforged Dwarves
races.description: Proud underground builders and master engineers known for their legendary armor, resilient bodies, and powerful clan traditions.

races.label: Storm Orcs
races.title: Storm Orcs
races.description: Nomadic warriors who live beneath thunderous skies and channel the fury of storms through ritual combat.

races.label: Drakari
races.title: Drakari
races.description: Dragon-blooded people who inherit elemental breath, powerful scales, and memories passed down from their ancient ancestors.

races.label: Feykin
races.title: Feykin
races.description: Playful and unpredictable beings from the enchanted forests who use illusion, charm, and nature magic to confuse their enemies.

races.label: Goblins
races.title: Glimmer Goblins
races.description: Clever scavengers and inventive tinkerers who turn discarded objects into dangerous tools, traps, and unpredictable weapons.

races.label: Hollowborn
races.title: Hollowborn
races.description: Undead souls who have regained their free will and now seek a purpose in a world that fears and hunts them.

races.label: Humans
races.title: Aetherian Humans
races.description: Adaptable explorers who have settled nearly every region of Aetheria and learned to combine many different forms of magic.

classes.label: Warrior
classes.title: Warrior
classes.description: A heavily trained frontline fighter who protects allies and overwhelms enemies with powerful weapon techniques.

classes.label: Knight
classes.title: Knight
classes.description: A disciplined defender clad in heavy plate, trained to absorb massive damage and hold the frontline for their allies.

classes.label: Paladin
classes.title: Paladin
classes.description: A holy warrior who combines heavy martial combat with sacred light magic to heal allies and smite evil forces.

classes.label: Dark Knight
classes.title: Dark Knight
classes.description: A formidable knight who sacrifices their own vitality to channel dark magic and inflict heavy physical damage.

classes.label: Barbarian
classes.title: Barbarian
classes.description: A fierce berserker who enters chaotic rages to increase raw strength, movement speed, and resistance to crowd control.

classes.label: Monk
classes.title: Monk
classes.description: A martial artist who harnesses internal energy and rapid hand-to-hand combat techniques to overpower foes.

classes.label: Blademaster
classes.title: Blademaster
classes.description: A disciplined master of swordcraft who delivers high-burst physical damage through rapid strikes, counter-stances, and precise critical hits.

classes.label: Ranger
classes.title: Ranger
classes.description: A skilled hunter who excels at long-range combat, wilderness survival, tracking, and fighting alongside animal companions.

classes.label: Rogue
classes.title: Rogue
classes.description: A fast and deceptive assassin who uses stealth, traps, poisons, and precise attacks to eliminate enemies before they can respond.

classes.label: Thief
classes.title: Thief
classes.description: A quick-witted rogue who excels at stealing valuable loot, dodging incoming attacks, and exploiting critical weaknesses.

classes.label: Assassin
classes.title: Assassin
classes.description: A master of shadow techniques and lethal surprise attacks who strikes from behind to eliminate high-value targets instantly.

classes.label: Beastmaster
classes.title: Beastmaster
classes.description: A wilderness specialist who tames wild beasts, commanding powerful animals in battle to fight alongside them.

classes.label: Mage
classes.title: Mage
classes.description: A scholar of raw elemental magic who unleashes destructive fire, ice, and lightning spells upon groups of enemies.

classes.label: Cleric
classes.title: Cleric
classes.description: A divine servant who protects allies with healing magic, sacred shields, and powerful blessings against dark forces.

classes.label: Druid
classes.title: Druid
classes.description: A guardian of nature who commands plants, animals, storms, and shapeshifting abilities to adapt to any situation.

classes.label: Shaman
classes.title: Shaman
classes.description: A spiritual guide who calls upon elemental totems and ancestral spirits to buff allies and weaken opponents.

classes.label: Enchanter
classes.title: Enchanter
classes.description: A tactical spellcaster specializing in battlefield crowd control, enemy mind control, and powerful support illusions.

classes.label: Bard
classes.title: Bard
classes.description: A traveling performer whose music inspires allies, weakens enemies, and changes the mood of entire battlefields.

classes.label: Necromancer
classes.title: Necromancer
classes.description: A forbidden spellcaster who commands undead minions and converts life energy into destructive curses.

classes.label: Summoner
classes.title: Summoner
classes.description: A magical scholar who forms pacts with ancient avatars and elemental spirits to call them forth in battle.

classes.label: Alchemist
classes.title: Alchemist
classes.description: A resourceful experimenter who concocts volatile explosives, restorative elixirs, and debilitating chemical mixtures to control the field.
